The most commonly supported identity providers are **Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, and Ping Identity**. Yes, you can use a different SAML 2.0–compliant identity provider.

[Identity providers for SAML SSO](https://docs.mistral.ai/platform/enterprise/saml#identity-providers)
